name: TBG Basic Scheduler Normalized (denoise methods)
plain: A core scheduler with six ways to apply denoise below 1. 'normalized' (default) takes the tail of a longer schedule like core, then scales it so its largest value equals the denoise number, which only makes sense for flow models where sigma runs 0 to 1. 'normalized advanced' finds the step whose sigma is closest to denoise, cuts there, resamples the tail to the step count, and rescales to max = denoise. 'multiplyed' multiplies the full schedule by denoise, and 'multiplyed normalized' scales max to denoise. Surprise: the tail-crop methods keep 'steps' values, one fewer than core's steps+1, so you get one step less, and 'default short' keeps only ceil(steps·denoise) values.
math:
Symbols: S(n) core schedule with n steps; d denoise; k steps.
default: S(⌊k/d⌋)[−k:].
normalized: σ = S(⌊k/d⌋)[−k:]; σ ← σ·d/max σ.
normalized advanced: c = argmin|S(k) − d|; σ = interp_k(S(k)[c:]); σ ← σ·d/max σ.
multiplyed: S(k)·d. multiplyed normalized: S(k)·d/max S(k).
default short: S(k)[−⌈k·d⌉:]. d = 1: S(k).
